buildCommand: if [ -f scripts/check-migration-safety.sh ]; then bash scripts/check-migration-safety.sh; elif [ -f ../../scripts/check-migration-safety.sh ]; then bash ../../scripts/check-migration-safety.sh; else echo "⚠️ 迁移安全检查脚本不存在，跳过安全检查"; fi && pnpm --filter cookmate-web exec -- prisma migrate deploy --schema=../../prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm run build
